deep_dive.title: Dynamic Latent Space Modeling of Inhomogeneous Poisson Network Processes with Applications to International Relations
deep_dive.abstract: We study continuous-time relational event data, where time-stamped dyadic interactions reflect both individual node propensities and evolving relational proximity. We propose a dynamic latent space model for inhomogeneous Poisson processes, where event intensities depend on node-specific activity parameters and time-varying latent distances modeled via flexible B-splines. We prove model identifiability by decoupling baseline activity from latent position, ensuring high interaction volumes do not warp the spatial map. For scalability, we develop a minibatch stochastic gradient algorithm with stable initialization and geometric anchoring, alongside an effective-degrees-of-freedom BIC for tuning model complexity. Simulations confirm accurate parameter recovery and out-of-sample prediction. Applied to cooperative diplomatic events among 60 major economies (1995--2022), the model uncovers shifting patterns of international cooperation and isolates mobile geopolitical actors from stationary institutional anchors.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Continuous-time relational events reflect node propensities and evolving proximity. The paper proposes a dynamic latent space model for inhomogeneous Poisson processes with B-spline time-varying distances, proving identifiability and offering scalable estimation.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 连续时间关系事件数据中，带时间戳的二元交互同时反映节点活跃度与演化的关系邻近性，但已有模型难以兼顾可识别性与可扩展性。作者提出非齐次泊松过程的动态隐空间模型，事件强度由节点活动参数与B样条建模的时变隐距离决定，并通过解耦基线活跃度与隐位置证明模型可识别性。作者还开发小批量随机梯度算法与基于有效自由度的BIC，应用于国际关系数据。
